continuity.palette_arc: Begin with warm household ochre and cream for the birth-star celebration; move through broken-wood ochres and deep maroon contours during the alarm; settle into calm indigo-blue, muted foliage and warm cream as the family and community reassure the child.
continuity.narrative_arc: Yashoda prepares the birth-star celebration; the cart breaks; Vraja adults arrive and debate the cause; the women check the infant; Nanda embraces him; the hidden cart demon is released; blessings and Bhattathiri’s prayer close the chapter.
continuity.notes: Keep Krishna as the same two-armed infant throughout D042; no four-armed form is specified in this chapter.
